title: The First Encounter — Romantic Dialogue Test

scenes.prompt: Use the reference image as the exact first frame. Preserve both characters' identities, faces, hairstyles, skin colors and clothing. The woman listens, smiles, then replies in a playful natural female voice: "Are you always this mysterious?" The prince gives a soft genuine laugh and answers: "Only when I meet someone special." She laughs softly with him. Show clear conversational turn-taking, expressive eyes, natural blinking, subtle head movements and visible mouth movement while each person speaks. Warm romantic chemistry, realistic facial acting, gentle breeze, golden sunset, photorealistic cinematic science-fiction romance. Generate synchronized native dialogue audio and soft natural laughter. No narrator, no extra dialogue, no subtitles, no text, no extra people, no face morphing, no identity or outfit changes.
